content.thesis_summary: USD 2,000 into AI infrastructure via diversified US-listed large-cap equities and ETFs. Focus on semiconductor leaders and AI-themed ETFs to capture infrastructure spend growth while avoiding single-name concentration.

rationale.NVDA: Leading GPU and AI accelerator provider; core AI infrastructure holding.
rationale.AMD: Competing GPU and CPU platform; growing AI data center exposure.
rationale.AVGO: Custom AI silicon and networking; high-margin AI infrastructure revenue.
rationale.MSFT: Azure cloud AI platform; diversified large-cap AI infrastructure exposure.
rationale.AMZN: AWS cloud AI services; largest cloud provider by revenue.
rationale.BOTZ: Broad AI and robotics ETF; diversified theme exposure with moderate expense ratio.
rationale.SOXX: Semiconductor ETF; captures the full AI chip supply chain.
